transport_contract.credentials_source: WordPress wp-config constants or WordPress options; credentials are not stored in this contract.

hard_rules: Do not infer search volume, intent or core_keyword when no real DataForSEO response exists.
DataForSEO validates SEO evidence only. It may not decide world, parent, leaf family, portal role, CORE promotion or deletion.
Leaf capacity counts only deduplicated, genuinely distinct article intents after ownership review.
A lowest-level category must be evaluated separately; total hobby-wide article count is insufficient.

request_plan.rationale: Subject logic already proposes leaf/article candidates. DataForSEO validates and deduplicates SEO intent evidence only.

postprocess: Collapse synonyms/near-duplicates by core_keyword + semantic equivalence.
Do not count wording variants twice.
Map validated intents back only to the subject-proposed leaf candidates.
Run cross-pillar ownership check before counting an intent toward CORE leaf capacity.
Apply concept-exact thresholds: under 4 combine/no leaf; 4 borderline; 5-12 ideal; 13-14 above ideal without automatic split; from about 15 review a real split.
For thin valid hobbies, test aggregation candidates without merging canonical hobby identities.
